summary: Polls open.er-api.com every 1d for what one USD is worth in EGP, GBP.

fill.id: A name for the address, lower case, digits and hyphens. The pack is rates-<id> and its poll rates_<id>, cut to 32 characters.
fill.url: The whole https:// address, written out and never computed. Its host goes in the summary and is the source of every row.
fill.every: How often it is asked. 1d is plenty, because a rate is read as of a day.
fill.base: The three-letter code the answer quotes against. It is the currency of every map, because one of it is worth each number.
fill.rates: Each other currency and where its number is in the answer, one map each, shaped as the first. A repeat and the base itself are left out; twenty is the most one poll fills.

author: BrainDog
